components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single primary action in a local decision area.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 44px; padding: 12px 18px; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; background: #0088ff; color: #fff; font: 600 16px/1.25 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background 120ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), transform 120ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #0072e0; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in oklab, #0088ff 55%, transparent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A neutral secondary action that does not compete with the primary.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 44px; padding: 12px 18px; border: 1px solid #dedfe4; border-radius: 12px; background: #fff; color: #1a1a1a; font: 600 16px/1.25 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background 120ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), border-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #f2f2f7; border-color: #cfd0d6; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in oklab, #0088ff 55%, transparent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Icon Button
components.description: A monochrome utility action with a full 44-pixel target.
components.html: <button class="ds-icon-button" aria-label="More actions"><svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="5" cy="12" r="2"/><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="2"/><circle cx="19" cy="12" r="2"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-icon-button { width: 44px; height: 44px; display: inline-grid; place-items: center; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: transparent; color: #1a1a1a; transition: background 120ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-icon-button:hover { background: color-mix(in oklab, #1a1a1a 6%, transparent); } .ds-icon-button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in oklab, #0088ff 55%, transparent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: A solid, legible field with explicit focus and no decorative glass.
components.html: <input class="ds-field" value="+240 Acme: Two screens" aria-label="Income line" />
components.css: .ds-field { min-height: 44px; box-sizing: border-box; width: 100%; padding: 12px 14px; border: 1px solid #dedfe4; border-radius: 12px; background: #fff; color: #1a1a1a; font: 400 16px/1.4 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: border-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), box-shadow 120ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-field:hover { border-color: #cfd0d6; } .ds-field:focus { border-color: #0088ff; outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, #0088ff 35%, transparent); }

components.name: Client Chip
components.description: A compact identity marker; color belongs to the client, not utility chrome.
components.css: .ds-client-chip { min-height: 32px; padding: 6px 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: #0088ff; color: #fff; font: 600 13px/1.25 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: filter 120ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), transform 120ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-client-chip:hover { filter: brightness(0.94); } .ds-client-chip:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-client-chip:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in oklab, #0088ff 45%, transparent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ledger Row
components.description: Amount-led, description-second, with quiet date metadata and explicit status.
components.html: +$240Launch Kit · Two screens29.06
components.css: .ds-ledger-row { min-height: 52px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0,1fr) auto auto; gap: 12px; align-items: center; padding: 8px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #e7e7eb; color: #1a1a1a; font: 400 16px/1.35 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-ledger-amount { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-weight: 650; } .ds-ledger-work { overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-ledger-date { color: #74757d; font-size: 13px; } .ds-ledger-status { width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 999px; background: #ff8a00; } .ds-ledger-row:focus-within { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in oklab, #0088ff 35%, transparent); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: Earnline feels like a carefully kept working notebook. The interface serves the ledger, keeps platform behavior familiar, and lets numbers, client names, work descriptions, and status carry the hierarchy.
keyCharacteristics: Restrained color with one blue interaction accent.
Dense but breathable ledger rows, not dashboard tiles.
Familiar platform controls with explicit states and generous targets.
Motion limited to state feedback, reveal, and spatial continuity.

rules.name: The Content-First Rule
rules.body: Every decorative decision must make the ledger easier to scan or operate. If it does neither, remove it.

rules.name: The Ten-Percent Accent Rule
rules.body: Signal Blue occupies no more than roughly 10% of a screen. Its scarcity makes actions legible.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: A resting content surface has no decorative shadow. If every region appears elevated, hierarchy has failed.

rules.name: The Functional Glass Rule
rules.body: Liquid Glass belongs to toolbars, navigation, menus, and transient controls. It is prohibited on summary cards, ledger rows, and content containers.

dos: Do put everyday actions within immediate reach and keep advanced controls intentionally recessed.
Do use one coherent monochrome icon language for utility actions.
Do compare before/after screenshots at the same simulator or viewport for every visual change.
donts: Don't use generic colored settings glyphs.
Don't turn settings or the ledger into a dense developer dashboard or enterprise admin console.
Don't use tiny floating controls or unexplained toolbar actions.
Don't use Liquid Glass, blur, or glassmorphism as a decorative content-card treatment.
